MarkerOn 
 
 中文 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lightweight screen annotation tool ( 1.5 MB) — press a hotkey ( keyboard-first ) to instantly draw, highlight, and annotate anywhere on your desktop. Built for demos, teaching, meetings, and screen recording. Free & open source. 
 

 
 
 

 Contents: Download · Quick Start · Features · Shortcuts · Feedback · Development

 Download

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Download Latest Release — pick the installer for your platform from the assets list. Windows also ships a portable zip ( x64 portable.zip ): extract and run — config stays under data\ next to the exe (no AppData).

Updates keep your existing shortcuts, appearance, brush widths, and toolbar position. Switching between the installer, Microsoft Store, and portable builds also migrates the previous config automatically.

Windows users can also install the Microsoft Store version with WinGet:

 

 Official downloads are GitHub Releases and Microsoft Store. Third-party mirrors may be outdated or repackaged.

 Quick Start

1. Install and launch — MarkerOn runs in the system tray ; no window appears.
2. Enter annotation mode — press Ctrl + Shift + D ( Command + Shift + D on macOS).
3. Draw, then click through — use number keys and V (Select) for tools; press X to interact with apps below while keeping annotations visible; press Esc to exit.

 New here? Press Space for the toolbar. See Keyboard Shortcuts for the full list.

 Features

- Lightweight & fast — 1.5 MB installer (Rust + Canvas), minimal memory; runs quietly in the system tray (no extra daemons or telemetry)
- Annotate anywhere — draw over any app, including the taskbar
- 11 tools — select, pen, highlighter, laser, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, line, eraser, text, stamp
- Stroke styles — press D to cycle solid → dashed → dotted ( Shift + D reverses) for pen, line, arrow, rectangle, and ellipse
- Hold to straighten — while drawing with pen/highlighter, hold still 0.5s to lock into a straight line and keep dragging to preview (only near-straight strokes snap — loops and elbows keep their shape); hold Alt to draw a perfect line immediately
- Brush strokes — pen width follows how fast you write (thin when you race, thick when you dwell), with a short, sharp landing and a long trailing tail, so handwriting looks brushed; toggle it in Settings → General 
- Marquee batch edit — press V for Select: box/click select, group drag, corner reshape, top-handle rotate, Delete to remove
- Flexible toolbar — press Space to toggle, or enable always-on in Settings; compact panel with Expand for full options, undo, copy, and whiteboard actions in-panel; independent floating window with drawing / click-through toggles
- Click-through mode — interact with apps below while staying in the session; toggle via toolbar buttons, Ctrl + Shift + X (global), or X while drawing; disabled in whiteboard mode
- Full keyboard control — every action has a shortcut, no menus needed
- Preserve drawings — enable Keep ink after exit under Whiteboard & content so the toggle-annotation shortcut leaves ink on screen (click-through); one Esc also leaves the ink, a second Esc tucks the layer away with the ink kept for next time
- Whiteboard mode — set default entry to whiteboard, or press W to toggle; choose white or black board color under Whiteboard & content 
- Whiteboard copy — copy the whiteboard as an image with Ctrl / Command + C 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Keyboard Shortcuts

On macOS , use Command (⌘) in place of Ctrl , and Option (⌥) in place of Alt .

 Global Shortcuts

 Action Windows macOS 
 :--- :--- :--- 
 Toggle annotation mode Ctrl + Shift + D Command + Shift + D 
 Clear all annotations Ctrl + Shift + C Command + Shift + C 
 Toggle click-through mode Ctrl + Shift + X Command + Shift + X 

 Tool Switching

 Key Tool Key Tool 
 :---: :--- :---: :--- 
 V Select 5 Ellipse 
 1 Pen 6 Line 
 2 Highlighter 7 Eraser 
 3 Arrow 8 Laser 
 4 Rectangle T Text 
 N Stamp 

 Common Actions

 Action Windows macOS 
 :--- :--- :--- 
 Toolbar (toggle) Space Space 
 Delete selection Delete / Backspace Delete / Backspace 
 Click-through (while drawing) X X 
 Cycle eraser mode (stroke / object) 7 again while eraser selected 7 again while eraser selected 
 Toolbar always-on / layout Settings → General Settings → General 
 Copy screen / whiteboard Ctrl + C Command + C 
 Copy / paste selection Ctrl + C / V Command + C / V (with a selection, C copies it instead of the screen) 
 Whiteboard toggle W W 
 Undo / Redo Ctrl + Z / Y Command + Z / Y 
 Stroke width Ctrl + Scroll Command + Scroll (pen, laser & shapes share; highlighter/eraser/text separate) 
 Stroke style (solid / dashed / dotted) D / Shift + D D / Shift + D (pen, line, arrow, rect, ellipse) 
 Exit Esc Esc 

 
 All shortcuts 

 Drawing with Modifier Keys

 Draws Windows macOS 
 :--- :--- :--- 
 Current tool (default: pen) Drag Drag 
 Line Alt + Drag Option + Drag 
 Rectangle Ctrl + Drag Command + Drag 
 Square Ctrl + Alt + Drag Command + Option + Drag 
 Ellipse Shift + Drag Shift + Drag 
 Circle Shift + Alt + Drag Shift + Option + Drag 
 Arrow Ctrl + Shift + Drag Command + Shift + Drag 

 Edit & Move

 Action Effect 
 :--- :--- 
 Select tool ( V ) Marquee or click to select; drag selection as a group; drag corners to resize, top handle to rotate ( Shift snaps; Alt resizes from the center); double-press V (or double-click the toolbar Select button) to select all; repeat to clear; Delete / Backspace to remove; Esc clears selection 
 Element dragging In General settings: Off / Hover drag / Hold Ctrl to drag 
 Double-click existing text Re-enter edit mode for that text 
 Double-click empty area in T mode Create a new text input at cursor position 

 Color & Stroke Style

 Action Effect 
 :--- :--- 
 Q / E Previous / Next color 
 D / Shift + D Cycle solid → dashed → dotted (Shift reverses); pen, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse 
 Right-click Hold to erase; release restores the previous tool 

 Other

 Action Windows macOS 
 :--- :--- :---
